says: In our tooling, law L2's importsOf follows static imports, re-exports and dynamic imports but not a type-position import("./x.ts") or a /// <reference path> line, both of which make tsc check the file, so a locked file reached only that way can have its check turned off with the law still green; oxlint-plugins/README.md line 125 says such a file cannot slip past the walk.
proof: In a scratch worktree of dd597afa9: a new .agents/skills/lead/scripts/zzT.ts holding Math.random(), reached from records.ts only by `export type ZY = import("./zzT.ts").Z;`. tsc -p .agents with no override printed zzT.ts(1,24) effect(globalRandom); with an override in .agents/tsconfig.json setting globalRandom off for that file, tsc printed 0 errors and effect-checks.test.ts printed 1 passed. The same with a top-of-file /// <reference path="./zzT.ts" />: tsc 0 errors, law 1 passed. No file in scope is reached only these ways today.
cost: A later file reached only by a type import or a reference line could have a locked check turned off without the law failing.
